items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I was afraid of them not recording me. Mayo Williams put the fear of death in me, which was stupid.

ctx.x: So why didn't you put in a claim right then and there with those guys who were all around?
I was afraid of them not recording me. Mayo Williams put the fear of death in me, which was stupid.
He didn't record you anymore anyway.
